notes.title: Space Kitten: An Easy Survival Game Demo is Now Live
notes.content:
🚀 Space Kitten: An Easy Survival Game Demo is Now Live! 🌟

Hello, Space Adventurers!

We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for Space Kitten: An Easy Survival Game is now available for download! 🐱✨

What is Space Kitten?
Space Kitten is an open-world survival crafting game that combines the charm of an adorable kitten with the thrill of space exploration. Whether you're a seasoned survival expert or new to the genre, Space Kitten offers a relaxed, but challenging for everyone.

Key Features in the Demo:

 Explore the Cosmos: Venture through vast, colorful planets, each filled with unique biomes, resources, and secrets to discover.
 Craft & Survive: Gather materials, craft essential tools, and build your own cozy space base to protect yourself from the elements.
 Cute Companionship: Play as a cute, determined kitten exploring the universe. Your survival is in your paws!
 Easy to Pick Up: Designed to be easy and intuitive, Space Kitten ensures you’ll have a purr-fectly good time whether you’re crafting, exploring, or simply enjoying the beautiful, relaxing environments.

Why Play the Demo?
This demo is a sneak peek at what’s to come in the full game. We’ve designed it to give you a taste of the exploration, crafting, and survival mechanics that will make Space Kitten a unique and enjoyable experience. We’re also eager to hear your feedback to help us refine the game and make it the best it can be!
